Subject: Mutual Action Plan — Stakeholder roster & evaluation timeline

Hi Rebecca & Samir,

Thanks again for taking the demo yesterday — appreciated the thoughtful questions from the infra team. Per our conversation, I'd like to get a short MAP kickoff on the calendar so we can:

- Confirm stakeholder roles (decision-maker, technical lead, security reviewer, procurement)
- Align on acceptance criteria for the eval/POC and a proposed 4-week timeline
- Share evaluation resources (eval checklist, scoring rubric) and calendar/Zoom logistics

Proposed times (PT):
- Mon Jan 12, 10:00–10:45am
- Tue Jan 13, 2:00–2:45pm

Draft agenda (45 min):
1) Introductions & roles (10 min)
2) MAP objectives & success criteria (10 min)
3) Eval plan and resources (10 min)
4) Calendar, milestones, and owners (10 min)
5) Q&A / next steps (5 min)

I've attached a lightweight MAP draft (MAP-draft-EDGESTREAM-v1.pdf) and added a temporary calendar hold in the event we pick a time. Please confirm the best slot and who from your side will own day-to-day POC coordination.

Zoom (provisional): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=MAPKickoff
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFG-EdgeStream-MAP

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Aditya Rao

+1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks Aditya — this looks good. We can do Mon Jan 12 at 10am PT. I'll loop in our Engineering manager, Samir Patel (copied).

Quick notes from our side:
- Suggested POC = 4 weeks; primary success criteria are: throughput within 20% of your benchmark, <200ms median token latency for our 2k prompt mix, and deterministic logging for audit.
- Samir will own the technical evaluation; I will own business validation and procurement alignment.
- We do need a short section in the MAP that lists out required evidence for security/compliance (SOC 2, data retention, encryption-at-rest). Can Neha cover that on the kickoff?
